headline: Brazil and Philippines sign trade agreements covering agriculture and competition
summary: Brazilian President Lula da Silva and Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed trade and agricultural agreements to boost Brazilian exports of pork and ethanol to the Philippines.
why: Brazil is a major global agricultural exporter, while the Philippines is expanding international supply ties to ensure food and fuel security.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Bilateral trade agreements open larger market opportunities for Brazilian agri-food and ethanol exports.
